article.title: Memphis faces Toronto, looks to break 3-game slide
article.linkText: Memphis faces Toronto, looks to break 3-game slide
article.story: Memphis Grizzlies (6-3, seventh in the Western Conference) vs. Toronto Raptors (5-4, sixth in the Eastern Conference) Toronto; Monday, 7:30 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: Memphis comes into the matchup with Toronto as losers of three in a row. Toronto went 46-36 overall with a 24-17 record at home during the 2025-26 season. The Raptors averaged 29.5 assists per game on 42.6 made field goals last season. Memphis went 25-57 overall last season while going 11-30 on the road. The Grizzlies averaged 114.7 points per game last season, 18.0 from the free-throw line and 41.7 from deep. INJURIES: Raptors: Kawhi Leonard: out (knee), Nate Bittle: day to day (foot), Scottie Barnes: day to day (adductor), Immanuel Quickley: day to day (hamstring). Grizzlies: Scotty Pippen Jr.: day to day (back), Isaiah Stewart: day to day (knee). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
